options.metric: Sum of pedestrians killed in reported crashes
options.reason: Bars make the number killed in each calendar year easy to compare directly.
options.interpretation: This answers the question with the annual sum of the crash records’ pedestrian-fatality counts, and the bars show a high of 176 in 2013 and a low of 101 in 2020. Absolute annual totals are a direct way to answer how many people were killed each year; this view does not explain causes or adjust for population or travel exposure.

options.metric: Sum of pedestrians killed in reported crashes
options.reason: A line chart emphasizes how the annual pedestrian death count changes over time.
options.interpretation: This answers the question with yearly pedestrian-fatality totals and highlights their movement over time, falling from 176 in 2013 to a low of 101 in 2020 before reaching 119 in 2025. Connecting yearly counts makes the temporal pattern easy to see; the chart does not explain why counts changed or adjust them for population or travel exposure.
